subject: Walled environment technical deep-dive — booking and constraints
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@walledhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: IT Ops <itops@walledhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-30 09:12 -0700
Subject: Request: private deployment architecture review (VPC + air-gapped constraints)

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week. We need a focused technical deep-dive with your infra/ops engineers to validate how Redwood would operate inside our walled environment. Key constraints:
- No outbound internet from inference hosts (air-gap via proxy jump host)
- Customer-managed KMS and HSM on-prem
- Allowed egress only via an approved NAT/ingress gateway for updates

Can we schedule a 90-minute session next week to walk networking, KMS integration, logging/audit plans, and the proposed preflight checklist?

Attaching a short PoC requirements doc. Our team: myself (product), IT Ops (cc). Please propose two time slots.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Director, Platform Engineering
Walled Health

Attachment: walledhealth_poc_requirements.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@walledhealth.com>
Cc: IT Ops <itops@walledhealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30 11:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: private deployment architecture review (VPC + air-gapped constraints)

Hi Alice —

Really appreciate the clear constraints. Hannah (ops lead) and I can cover the networking patterns and KMS design. Proposed slots (PST):
- Tues 2026-09-01 09:30–11:00
- Wed 2026-09-02 13:00–14:30

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions and scope (10m)
2) Network/topology options (30m)
3) KMS/HSM and key lifecycle patterns (20m)
4) Logging/audit & evidence collection (15m)
5) Preflight checklist and next steps (15m)

I'll attach our preflight checklist and a draft network diagram for discussion. Do either slot work for you?

Best,
Ben Carter
Manager, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-private-deploy-preflight-checklist.xlsx, networking-diagram-draft.png
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@walledhealth.com>, IT Ops <itops@walledhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-30 13:40 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: private deployment architecture review (VPC + air-gapped constraints)

Ben / Alice —

Heads up: I'm booked for the Tue morning slot with an executive review that can't move. Wed 13:00 would work for me. If Wed is tight for your team, I can join virtually for the first 45 minutes and hand off to Sean for the remainder.

Also would like to confirm whether you expect us to demonstrate a proof-of-concept-run or if this session is purely design + checklist. Knowing that will change whether we bring a small demo environment.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@walledhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-31 08:22 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: private deployment architecture review (VPC + air-gapped constraints)

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. Wed 2026-09-02 13:00–14:30 PST is OK for me and matches Ben's second option. I can take lead on the networking and KMS sections. To set expectations, we'll plan for:

- 15m: high-level topology options (NAT gateway, jump-proxy pattern, egress controls)
- 25m: secure key handling and HSM integration (bring sequence diagrams)
- 20m: logging, evidence collection, and SOC2-relevant artefacts
- 20m: preflight checklist review + action items
- 10m: Q&A and next steps

Prep items for Walled Health (please upload before EOD Mon):
- All allowed CIDR ranges and any enforced firewall rules
- KMS vendor and version details, HSM model if applicable
- Compliance evidence expectations (e.g., what metadata you need from our audit logs)

I'll attach the preflight checklist (attached) and a short template for the SOC2 evidence request so we can align. If you prefer a 90-minute hands-on PoC instead of design-only, let us know — we can bring a minimal demo but it will require a short temporary connectivity path.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-private-deploy-preflight-checklist.xlsx
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@walledhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-01 15:47 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: private deployment architecture review (VPC + air-gapped constraints)

Thanks — Wed 2026-09-02 13:00–14:30 PST works. We've uploaded the CIDR and firewall rules doc to the Drive link and attached the HSM model number. We definitely want design-first; if we later schedule a PoC we'll coordinate a temporary, approved egress path with IT Ops.

One ask before the session: can you include a short section on how redwood's preflight validates offline update delivery (we need to understand the patch/update mechanism for models/kernels without outbound access)? Also we need an example of the audit log JSON payload — can you paste a sanitized sample into the shared Drive?

See you Wednesday.

Alice Chen
Director, Platform Engineering
Walled Health

Related link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcD_walled_poc_requirements
Attachment: walledhealth_hsm_spec.pdf
